checked_decisions.finding: Kyoshiro's third-person self-name 'Plamo-Kyoshiro' compressed to first person ('me'/'my strength and wit') to fit the 26/30-char budgets; the exuberant self-boast is preserved, no identity is invented or lost, so this is compression, not a meaning error.
'Oni-san kochira' hide-and-seek taunt reduced to a generic 'Over here!' under a 12-char budget; the game-reference flavor is lost but the taunting intent (luring the opponent) is kept intact.
Unidentified opponents ('こんな奴', 'あいつ') correctly rendered gender-neutral ('this one'/'that one'); no gender or identity invented, per project rule.

Extreme 10-char budget forces 'What now?!' for a line literally about bewildered disbelief at the opponent ('what IS that guy'); this drops the specific target-reference but keeps the surprised-reaction tone. No better fit exists at 10 characters; not a reversal, left as compression.

'Aidoin  Ampu chanpion' (broken-English katakana joke, lit. 'I am champion') is kept as the equally broken 'I am champion!' rather than corrected to grammatical English -- this is the right call, since 'fixing' the grammar would erase the source's own joke.

'Plamo Spirit' (literal rendering of the source's own katakana coinage) and the Yamato-damashii idiom (compressed to 'That's spirit!' at an exact 14-char fit) both preserve the celebratory boast; no reversal.

'Yudan dekinai zo' (self-directed 'I can't let my guard down') rendered as the imperative 'Stay sharp!'. Per BASE_RULES, an ambiguous-addressee imperative is the preferred construction over inventing a subject pronoun; kept as is.

'Ore hitori de juubun da' ('I alone am enough') compressed to 'One's enough!'; read in context as self-assurance (I alone am enough for this), matching the source, not as a claim about enemy numbers. Fits budget (13/14 chars).

Confirmed the speaker boundary: rows 16213-16290 are Kyoshiro (resource 2824012, Perfect Gundam); rows 16291-16292 already belong to Isamu Alva Dyson (resource 2825010, YF-19), matching shout_groups.json and the batch file's own speaker note. Both exclamations ('Yeeeehaaawww!', 'Come on, come on!!') fit his reckless/carefree voice.

uncertainties.issue: Ruling: translator's compression of Kyoshiro's self-naming to first person is correct and required by the byte budget; no fix needed.
Ruling: loss of the 'oni-san kochira' children's-game reference is acceptable compression under a 12-char budget; no fix needed.
Ruling: gender-neutral phrasing for unidentified opponents is the correct call per project rule; no fix needed.
Ruling: 'What now?!' under a 10-char budget is the best available compression of a bewildered-reaction line; approximate but not a reversal; no fix needed.
Ruling: 'Plamo Spirit' literal rendering is fine pending its own glossary proposal; no fix needed here.
Ruling: dropping the named 'Yamato damashii' idiom for 'That's spirit!' is required by an exact 14-char fit; no fix needed.
